_about: Methanol (1) + Methyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of methanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of methanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Shang, Wenyan, Cui, Xianbao, Yu, Xufeng, Zhang, Ying, Feng, Tianyang, He, Jie, Zhang, Xuemei, Wang, Jixiao, Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium for methanol + methyl acetate with ionic liquids [OMMIM][Tf2N] and [OMIM][Tf2N] as entrainers at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 473 (2018) 90-97
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9, 10. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0040. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.14 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
